title: The Totals row stays visible while only the active tab's body scrolls
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. A tab has more rows than fit on the screen.
steps:
1. Scroll the rows up and down and watch the Totals row.
2. Look at the page for a second scrollbar outside the table.
expected: 1. The Totals row stays visible at the bottom while the rows scroll. 2. The report fills the available height and only the active tab's table body scrolls — the page itself does not add a second scrollbar. --- This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Work In Progress report specification version 28 (S10-R4, S10-R5), read on 18 August 2026.
